Save Your Listens

Project Description:  
The Save Your Listens page  (SYL) is a webpage where users can enter a song they listened to recently and want to share their thoughts on. The page will let users save notes and ratings of these songs, along with the songs information so that they can share their musical taste with others. We chose this project idea because music taste is a really personal thing, and it can be hard to really show someone the depth of your understanding and connection with music. This page will allow users to have a reference point that they can share as evidence and explanation of their taste.

Target Users:  
This project is really designed for anyone who listens to music. From avid audiophiles to casual car-radio listeners, this page is for all ages and demographics. Most users will likely share with their friends and family, so the user-base should expand quickly as well.

Context:  
The SYL page would function as its own website where users have their own page that they can add songs to, and would have embeddable capabilities as well, to show a user’s top 5 songs, or other preset metrics. Places that users may wish to embed could be social media platforms (like instagram, or twitter) or a personal blog page.

Task Distribution:  
One team member will be responsible for handling the database functions and formatting, and making sure that all information that needs to be retrieved, can be, and that all information that needs to be added, can be. Another team member will focus on the actual page design format and UI, making it look nice, while being functional. The last team member will focus on connecting the database functions to the actual page, and implementing an embed page that can be referenced on other sites.
